mix_ratio.text: The adhesive used to bond the SikaCeram® Sealing Membrane A system: SikaTile 440 Opti-Cure mixed neat with Lanko Latex 751 Additive.

mix_ratio.text: Application Type | SikaTile-440 Opti-Cure | Lanko Latex 751 | Estimated coverage

mix_ratio.text: ▪ Do not dilute the Lanko latex 751 - use neat.

mix_ratio.text: Trowel size 2.6mm V notched trowel for board substrates

mix_ratio.label: Mixing ratio
mix_ratio.text: Trowel size 3.5mm V notched trowel for concrete and screed susbstrates

mix_ratio.label: Mixing ratio
mix_ratio.text: Add the Lanko Latex 751 additive to a clean mixing bucket. Slowly add the SikaTile 440 Opti-Cure to the bucket while stirring with an electric mixing drill.

mix_ratio.label: Mixing ratio
mix_ratio.text: Mix the adhesive to a smooth lump free mixture and allow the mixture to stand or "slake" for 3 minutes.

mix_ratio.label: Mixing ratio
mix_ratio.text: Restir the adhesive for an additional 1 minute then the adhesive can be used.

mix_ratio.label: Mixing ratio
mix_ratio.text: The adhesive may need restirring during its pot life, do not add any additional Lanko latex 751.
